summary: Bounded exact-ID GET recovery now traverses attributed unresolved persisted orders independently of age through startup, reconnect and periodic reconciliation. Existing atomic accounting remains the sole fill application path.
behavior: Eligibility requires an existing broker UUID and original client key, nonterminal local state, plus organism source attribution or an exact order.submitted outbox order/client identity. Unknown legacy rows and missing broker identities are excluded.

Up to20 requests per pass,2 seconds per broker lookup,10 seconds for the entire asynchronous page/read/lookup/row-lock/accounting/commit scope. An immutable-ID process-local cursor advances before each attempted row, including errors/timeouts; a completed sweep wraps.

Responses must match original broker ID, client ID, symbol, side and requested quantity. Nonfinite/bool/negative/excess fill quantities, missing positive-fill prices, unknown status, any replaced status and filled status with less than requested quantity remain unresolved.

After each GET the qualifying row is selected under lock and immutable identity rechecked. Existing apply_order_fill_snapshot handles incremental cashflow and idempotency in the same transaction as status/execution/lots/audit; commit occurs only after success.
Only exact GET is used by this service. No submission, cancellation, outbox mutation or invented terminal status on404/unavailable response.

Reconnect retains the preceding connection boundary until its bounded recent-history lookup uses it; fresh connect no longer overwrites that anchor before recovery. Existing one-hour maximum recent-history lookback is preserved.

validation.postgres_safety: Dedicated postgres:16-alpine, new internal Docker network, no published ports, tmpfs database; existing immutable API image runs candidate read-only mount with synthetic credentials and scratch brain. Six actual DB cases plus five URL safety validation cases. Original four contention proofs retained.
postgres_new_proofs: Actual PostgreSQL JSON lineage predicate and UUID keyset select old attributable rows while excluding wrong-client/unowned rows.
pg_blocking_pids confirms recovery waits for concurrent stream partial-fill transaction; then applies only6 incremental shares after4 shares, total cost1120, one final10-share summary.

freeze.environment: Recorded non-secret candidate variables only; no runtime read.

validation.initial_red_explanation: New SQLite fixture used all-numeric UUID text, which SQLite converted to integer. Changed synthetic UUID prefix to alphabetic; no production UUID workaround or weakened assertion.
validation.warnings: Six pre-existing deprecation/legacy websocket mock coroutine warnings retained in expanded log.

limits: Process-local cursor resets on restart; repeated restarts can delay later rows. This is bounded eventual traversal within a continuing process, not immediate complete history reconciliation.
Unowned historical UNKNOWN, missing broker ID and already-terminal old history are intentionally not auto-rewritten. An unavailable exact broker lookup remains unresolved and observable.
Recently terminal recovery remains separately bounded by existing100-row/one-hour reconnect and latest500 startup windows. Arbitrary old closed history is not reconstructed.
Existing delayed ACK writer can regress an order summary after a fill; its separate repair is being reviewed by the owning agent. This change does not claim every writer is monotonic.
Async deadlines cancel cooperative awaits and roll back session contexts; this does not guarantee a hard OS-level wall bound against uncooperative dependencies.
No active runtime, broker, production database, credentials, saved brain, freeze cutoff, deployment or trading decision parameter was changed.
handoff: Root owns full artifact pack, CI wiring, documentation, commits/PR and later deployment acceptance. Independent reviewer binds acceptance separately; this report does not self-approve deployment.
